newsitem.title: UK: Former Conservative MP joins UK Labour.
newsitem.headline: Former Conservative MP joins UK Labour.

text.p: A former Conservative MP will announce he has left the minority Liberal Democrats to join the opposition Labour Party, a Labour spokeswoman said on Tuesday.

Christopher Brocklebank-Fowler, who was MP for Kings Lynn in eastern England from 1970 to 1983, was the only Conservative MP to defect to the newly-formed Social Democratic Party when it was formed in 1981.
He stood as a Liberal Democrat in the 1992 general election in the seat of South Norfolk, taking second place to the Conservatives.
